events.quote: Air France-KLM has placed €650 million of senior unsecurred bonds on January 8, 2026, with a maturity of 5 years and a fixed annual coupon of 3.875% (yield of 4.033%) under its EMTN program.
events.summary: The group raised new senior unsecured debt under its EMTN programme and redeemed a convertible subordinated hybrid bond, reshaping its debt profile and hybrid capital base.
events.title: Bond issuance and hybrid redemption

events.quote: On October 15, Air France–KLM Group notified the holders of last-rank indefinite subordinated bond convertible into new shares and/or existing shares its intention to redeem all of the outstanding hybrid Bonds from the First Hard Call Date at a price per hybrid Bonds equal to par (€100,000) plus accrued interest of 1,625 euro.
events.summary: The group redeemed its last-rank perpetual convertible bonds, reducing hybrid capital and requiring cash outflow.
events.title: Redemption of convertible subordinated hybrid bonds

events.quote: On October 22, 2025, Air France-KLM finalized the acquisition of a 2.3% stake in the capital of Canadian airline WestJet for a total amount of $49 million. This transaction, initially announced on May 9, 2025, remained subject to certain approvals.
events.summary: The group bought a minority stake in Canadian carrier WestJet from its joint venture partner, deepening transatlantic cooperation but adding a non-consolidated equity investment.
events.title: Stake acquired in WestJet

events.quote: This last extension option was exercised in June 2025, bringing the maturity date to 2029.
events.summary: The group exercised an extension option on its revolving credit facility, pushing the maturity out and improving liquidity headroom.
events.title: Credit facility maturity extended

events.quote: Provided all the necessary conditions are met, Air France-KLM would fully acquire the stakes held by Castlelake and Lind Invest, bringing its own stake to 60.5%. The Danish State would retain its 26.4% stake in SAS and its seats on the Board of Directors.
events.summary: The group is progressing toward control of SAS, which would bring a large airline onto the balance sheet and change the consolidation scope.
events.title: Planned majority stake in SAS

events.summary: Staff costs rose faster than revenues, weighing on the operating margin and cash generation.
events.title: Higher salaries and related costs
